author: Partner Threat Feed
attributes.description: Identifies three or more hosts resolving command and control domains used by the Clay Stencil remote access trojan, as reported in campaign PTF-00796. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Clay Stencil Remote Access Trojan: Several hosts resolving command and control domains (PTF-00796)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Clay Stencil Remote Access Trojan: Several hosts resolving command and control domains

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Clay Stencil remote access trojan in campaign PTF-00796.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
attributes.query:
FROM logs-endpoint.events.network-*
| WHERE dns.question.name IN ("cloud-data29.test", "edge-media14.invalid", "media-relay77.test", "node-media58.invalid", "update-relay17.test")
| STATS host_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.id), hosts = VALUES(host.name) BY dns.question.name
| WHERE host_count >= 3
